name: Hazuki Yuzuko
source:
Favorite subject: Geography
Hobbies: Collecting seals, exercising
Favorite food: Yakitori
Hated food: Onions

A first-year student belonging to the Lacrosse Club. She has impressive reflexes and is always in a lively, cheerful mood, often making noise when everyone is gathered around. However, in reality she is lonely.
